source: mcnerny2015, Bone 2015, author manuscript NIHMS714167, operator-supplied 2026-08-13, Table 1
design: Male C57Bl/6 (Charles River), weight-matched at 5 weeks into 5 groups, n=20/group. Daily subcutaneous BAPN 350 mg/kg/day or PBS for 3 weeks (days 1-21), with or without 30 min/day running. Left tibiae scanned by microCT over the ENTIRE LENGTH.
target_engagement_confirmed: BAPN significantly reduced lysylpyridinoline, pyrrole, hydroxylysinorleucine and TOTAL MATURE cross-linking; decreased elastic modulus; increased yield strain; and significantly reduced bodyweight (p=0.010).
epiphyseal_separation: NOT REPORTED. Whole-tibia microCT plus trabecular analysis in a volume 50 um below the PROXIMAL GROWTH PLATE; no physeal pathology described. Growth proceeded normally, 16.0 -> 17.2 mm in 3 weeks.
verdict: The class-safety objection (osteolathyrism / epiphyseal separation) is REFUTED at a length endpoint. The efficacy question is UNRESOLVED: the 95% CI is +/-0.97% and the human-equivalent effect is +0.80%, so the study cannot resolve it. Separately, BAPN moved cross-links and mechanics while leaving length, cortical geometry and ALL SIX cancellous parameters null - cross-linking sets bone mechanical quality, not bone length.
